label: Late-episode GO, stronger when S1 seems good and especially after a rewarded S1 visit.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * isin(ep_dec, [6, 7, 8]) * (belief_lo > 0) ;; (phase == GO) * isin(ep_dec, [6, 7, 8]) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * isin(ep_dec, [6, 7, 8]) * last_is("a1 S1 r")
terms: (phase == GO) * isin(ep_dec, [6, 7, 8]) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * isin(ep_dec, [6, 7, 8]) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * isin(ep_dec, [6, 7, 8]) * (belief_lo > 0) ;; (phase == GO) * isin(ep_dec, [6, 7, 8]) * (trial == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * isin(ep_dec, [6, 7, 8]) * (belief_lo > 0) * (trial == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_dec == 7) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 1)
explanation: Sparse feature (1.7% of steps) that fires only at GO, almost only in trials ~60-89. Its magnitude beyond timing goes up when the ideal observer favours S1, and the biggest jumps come after a rewarded S1 visit, most of all a rare a2->S1 reward (the model-based cue to switch to a1). Previous trials ending in S2 or without reward push it down. The timing baseline is additive, but the feature behaves multiplicatively (it only fires late in the episode), so every term is gated to deciles 6-8. Graded belief_lo, the trial before, and belief_cover add almost nothing. Big activations on the first GO of a window followed by decay over a streak of S1 rewards are under-predicted, and so is the remaining variance. Observed cues cap at about 0.14 (all 0.17), so most of the magnitude is not explained by these trial-history cues.
